name: Way of the Drunken Master
description: A legacy monk subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Bonus Proficiencies
grants.description: Gain proficiency in Performance and Brewer's Supplies.

grants.name: Drunken Technique
grants.description: After using Flurry of Blows, gain the benefits of Disengage and increase your Speed by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

grants.name: Leap to Your Feet
grants.description: Standing from Prone costs 5 feet of movement instead of half your Speed.

grants.name: Redirect Attack
grants.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to make that attack hit a different creature of your choice within 5 feet of the attacker, other than the attacker.

grants.name: Tipsy Sway
grants.description: You gain Leap to Your Feet and Redirect Attack.

grants.name: Drunkard's Luck
grants.description: When an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw has disadvantage, spend 2 Focus Points to cancel that disadvantage for the roll.

grants.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
grants.description: When using Flurry of Blows, make up to three additional attacks, for as many as five Flurry attacks total. Every Flurry attack that turn must target a different creature.
